item.description: Pakistan and Bangladesh are among the 10 worst hunger-hit countries globally, according to Action Against Hunger. Nigeria, DR Congo, Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan, Myanmar, South Sudan and Syria are also on the list. Acute hunger affects around 266 million people across 47 countries.

item.title: Air India, Air India Express extend Saudi Arabia flight suspension until Oct 24 amid Houthi strikes: What airline said
item.description: Air India and Air India Express have suspended flights to Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam until October 24 amid security concerns in West Asia following Houthi revel strikes. IndiGo on Thursday also extended the suspension of its flights to Saudi Arabian destinations until October 24.

item.title: Delhi Traffic Update: CR Park, GK-2 traffic curbs from 4 pm Saturday to midnight till October 20; check alternatives
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has warned of possible congestion on eight major roads in South Delhi amid Durga Puja celebrations in Chittaranjan Park and Greater Kailash-2. Restrictions will remain in place from 4 pm to midnight daily until October 20.&nbsp;

item.title: Iran says supertanker carrying 2 million barrels of crude ablaze after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran’s IRGC Navy said a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil caught fire after hitting a naval mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route. The incident comes amid rising attacks on shipping and Tehran’s tightening grip on the strategic waterway.

item.title: FSSAI notifies draft amendment to tighten infant nutrition rules: What are the changes being proposed?
item.description: FSSAI has proposed banning the addition of sucrose and fructose to infant nutrition products for babies up to six months old. The draft amendment is open for public feedback for 60 days before the regulator considers finalising it.

item.title: FSSAI proposes ban on added sugar in baby food for infants aged up to six months
item.description: FSSAI’s draft amendment seeks to prohibit sucrose and fructose in infant nutrition products intended for babies aged up to six months, tightening standards amid concerns over early sugar exposure and childhood obesity.

item.title: Shankar Mahadevan’s new Delhi restaurant Malgudi: Location, menu and what diners can expect
item.description: Singer-composer Shankar Mahadevan has opened Malgudi’s first Delhi outlet in Rajouri Garden. The vegetarian restaurant serves traditional South Indian dishes alongside fusion options, regional specialities and inventive coffee.&nbsp;

item.title: SC says internet access is a fundamental right, rejects blanket ban for children: ‘Safety and freedom are not at odds’
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled that children, like all individuals, have a fundamental right to access and use the internet.

item.title: Trump waives some Russia oil sanctions, easing pressure on India
item.description: The move offers relief to major Russian oil buyers as India and the US push to finalize a trade deal, with crude prices above $100 a barrel adding to pressure on New Delhi’s import bill and inflation.

item.title: Who is Natasha Narwal? 2020 Delhi riots case accused to travel to the UK for academic purposes
item.description: The Delhi High Court has allowed activist Natasha Narwal, who is out on bail in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case, to visit the UK for academic work. A founding member of Pinjra Tod, she must return to India, refrain from seeking asylum and surrender her passport within 48 hours of returning.

item.title: Global Hunger Index 2026: Pakistan ranks 106th out of 122, reports one of the poorest performances in South Asia
item.description: Pakistan ranked 106th of 122 countries in the 2026 Global Hunger Index, with a score of 25.5 indicating serious hunger. Economic hardship, rising food prices and climate shocks have strained food security, while undernourishment and child wasting have worsened since 2018.

item.description: Police identified 16-year-old Griffin J. John II as the shooter who killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon. A parent shot him dead inside the school.

item.description: Gabriella Rothberg, a 17-year-old student from Miami, is developing genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, a molecule associated with meat flavour. Her project could have nutritional applications, but its taste and health benefits remain unproven.
